title: gomphocarpus gracilis
intro: Gomphocarpus gracilis, commonly known as the small balloon plant or small balloon cottonbush, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Gomphocarpus gracilis include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and lower blood pressure.
